summary: Route Mode slice 1. Candidates for non-AI fields were very old and mostly without a legal PDF. Creation search now defaults to the last 10 years with an explicit any-year toggle; the refreshed feed uses a relative five-year window instead of the fixed 2024-01-01; papers carry a PDF status (direct / page only / none) shown on creation candidates and daily cards; direct-PDF papers come first within each block of six relevance results.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of 8307545. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call and no new outbound data; only open-access fields already fetched from OpenAlex are used.
budget_impact.before: Creation search had no date bound; the feed window was fixed at 2024-01-01; no PDF indicator.
budget_impact.after: Ten-year creation window (toggle), relative five-year feed window, PDF status labels and block-wise preference.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

open_risks: The 10-year and 5-year windows and the block size of 6 are unvalidated proposals.
Legal PDFs are scarce in materials science (live: 2 of 12 and 1 of 12 candidates); this slice labels that but cannot change it. An open-access-only toggle was not added.
Papers stored before open-access data was kept show 'none' until their record is refreshed.
The creation page and cards were not clicked through in the app window in this slice.
